gloss: to memorize thoroughly; to learn by heart

definitions.gloss: to memorize thoroughly; to learn by heart; to commit to memory
definitions.explanation: To learn something so completely that it becomes deeply ingrained. Implies a level of memorization that goes beyond surface-level recall, where the knowledge becomes second nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌詞|かし}→歌詞：13160_kashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To memorize the lyrics by heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}む。
⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}ませた。
examples.english: I practiced over and over until my body had it memorized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{台詞|せりふ}→台詞：04038_serifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}んで⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: The actor memorized the lines completely before going to rehearsal.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to remember, memorize) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (suffix indicating thoroughness or deep penetration). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ emphasizes that the memorization is deep and complete, not just surface-level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歌詞|かし}→歌詞：13160_kashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}む: to memorize lyrics
- ⟦{台詞|せりふ}→台詞：04038_serifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}む: to learn lines by heart
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}ませる: to train until it becomes muscle memory
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{覚|おぼ}え{込|こ}む: to memorize firmly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to memorize, remember — basic verb without the emphasis on thoroughness
- ⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to memorize by rote — formal; emphasizes the act of committing to memory, often text or data
- ⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire (a skill) — broader; includes learning skills and habits, not just memorization
